column4: Loan loss reserves cannot exceed the loans they are held against
The allowance for loan and lease losses is a contra-asset and cannot be negative
Loans are a component of assets and cannot exceed the total
A capital ratio cannot be negative

A tier 1 ratio above 1000pct is legitimate but rare -- a small bank holding almost only zero-risk-weight assets. NOT an error: the regulator's own reported ratio exceeds 1 for every one of these banks. See docs/QUALITY.md
Total capital includes tier 1 so its ratio cannot be smaller
Common equity tier 1 is a component of tier 1 capital
Risk-weighted assets far above total assets suggests a units or era-stitch error
Category charge-offs cannot exceed total charge-offs
Category recoveries cannot exceed total recoveries
